`Check Changeset` is red on 20d75f11 for exactly the two reasons this PR's Acceptance notes name, and neither can be fixed from this PR:

- `check-adr-0087-registration --base`: three predicate-1 refusals. The gate maps only tsup's `dist/index.d.ts` -> `src/index.ts`, and `@object-ui/plugin-ai`'s entry is `src/index.tsx`. The fix is the gate change plus the ADR-0087 D9 wording on #26220 (`Blocked-by: #26220`).
- `check-empty-changeset --base`: the one-line removal of `"@object-ui/plugin-ai": minor` from the pending `.changeset/25831-object-ui-18-1-to-merge.md`. This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: the package no longer exists, so restoring the line would make `changeset version` fail. The gate stays red until a maintainer confirms the edit; that confirmation has been asked for.

Every other step in the job passed: no major bump, the level axis reads `no (narrowing)` / `narrowed`, and protocol lockstep holds. No re-run: both failures are deterministic.

`Check Changeset` on bde1e722 (after merging `main` past the 18.2.0 release) has one red left. The `25831` correction is gone because 18.2 consumed that note, and `check-empty-changeset` is green.

The remaining red is `check-adr-0087-registration --base`: three predicate-1 refusals, `cannot be read at HEAD: no workspace manifest at HEAD is named @object-ui/plugin-ai`. The gate now maps the `.tsx` entry at the base. What it refuses is a whole-package removal, which leaves no HEAD manifest to read. This is a disposition decision for the maintainer (a D9 whole-package limb, or a `registered` disposition on this PR), so the marker stays as it is until that decision is made. No re-run: the failure is deterministic.
